content:
Priya Desai: Heads up — NimbusHealth showing ~70% drop in API calls last 7d, new procurement lead, and we've been pinged about a competitive eval (ClearServe). Can we triage quickly?
Tom Alvarez: Ack. Do we have token-level usage + top routes for the last 30d? Need to see if it's route-specific.
Maya Chen: Pulling now. Quick look: `generate_chat` down 68%, `embed_doc` flat. Will attach CSV in thread.
Priya Desai: Emma — you chatted with their champion last week, right? Any signs?
Emma Li: Yep. Champion Ravi moved to security. New PM is Claire M. Claire asked for side-by-side latency + cost benchmarking vs ClearServe. Wants simple p95 numbers per route.
Jamal Brooks: Recommend offering a short 2-week dedicated pilot (burst) to demonstrate p95 + throughput. We can configure `max_concurrency=50` and show real traffic. cc @OpsBot to provision.
OpsBot: provisioning request received: org=nimbus, env=dedicated-burst, duration=14d, target_gpus=2. Estimated ETA: 4h.
Maya Chen: I'll build a 1-slide perf summary + 1-slide cost calc: p95, median, tokens/day impact, plus basic eval checklist. Will add a link to runbook.
Tom Alvarez: Include regression checks (sample prompts) and a short hallucination baseline. Also capture exact model versions & quantization used.
Priya Desai: Also want a 30m enablement for Claire — runbook + integration checklist + how to read Console dashboards. Emma can you propose times?
Emma Li: Sending calendar invites now. Proposed slots: Thu 10:00am PT or Fri 2:00pm PT. I'll confirm with Claire.
Jamal Brooks: Pricing for pilot: rough calc `cost = tokens * 0.0004`. Example: 500k tokens/day ≈ $200/day. Recommend 50% pilot discount and a clear evaluation success metric (p95 < 200ms on routing).
Maya Chen: I'll drop the CSV and a small `curl` snippet for their infra team to replay sample traffic:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"route":"generate_chat","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Priya Desai: Perfect. Action items: Maya — deck + CSV by EOD; Ops — finish provision; Emma — confirm enablement slot + invite; Jamal — draft 2-week SOW & pilot pricing. We'll stand up a 10m sync after Ops confirms.
Tom Alvarez: I'll prepare the canary + rollback plan (auto-fallback to hosted model variant) in case they see regressions.
Emma Li: Claire asked if we can share a short customer reference. I have a willing contact at HelioHealth — can do a 15m call if needed.
Priya Desai: Good. Keep replies here. If we get a procurement RFP, route to me + Jamal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
